title: Build Node test repositories from explicit MakeMe data

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

**Story and revision.** SEED-262#migrate-backlog-scratch-repositories ("Build Node test repositories from explicit MakeMe data"), plan 524, at be51e7eb74c2f10e9da5540694e44c6de7ec316d.

**Promise.** Key example 2, "Developer under proof": the done-record test declares Terry Yin as the configured developer at its call site, the real `complete` records Terry Yin, and no fixture default supplies that name.

**Plausible fault.** The shared materializer loses the declared configured developer and configures its fixture default instead, while commits still carry the declared identity. In `tests/support/repository-fixture.mjs` `buildTemplate` (line 104), `await configureIdentity(integration, checkoutIdentity);` was changed to `await configureIdentity(integration, integrationDeveloper);` (default "Integration Checkout"). This path serves `materializeLocalCheckout`, which `checkoutOf` in `tests/support/product-backlog-git-fixture.mjs` uses.

**Fixture.** `tests/support/product-backlog-complete-credit.test.mjs`: each case builds `makeMe.aRepository.withCheckoutIdentity({ name: "Terry Yin", email: "terry@example.com" })...` through `checkoutOf`, then runs the real backlog CLI `complete --identity <story>`.

**Maintained assertion.** `assert.deepEqual(readRecord(project, fileName), { ..., developer: "Terry Yin", ... })` (lines 77, 124 and 173). Fixture and assertions were unchanged.

**Run observations.** These ran in a detached scratch worktree at the revision, with the workspace `node_modules` symlinked in. The pre-probe state was clean apart from that symlink. Each run used `env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/product-backlog-complete-credit.test.mjs`, with `OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES` and `OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES` files set to confirm the job ran.
- Baseline: exit 0, job outcome `passed`, 0.7 s.
- Fault: exit 1, job outcome `failed`, 0.6 s. Three of the four tests failed: "complete credits the execution agent even when a released preparation profile sorts first" (:31), "complete on a queued entry with only a preparation profile releases it without recording execution credit" (:93) and "a Taken profile recording no host or model leaves a record naming the agent only" (:151). Each failed with an AssertionError at the `readRecord` deepEqual (:77, :124, :173), showing `+ developer: 'Integration Checkout'` against `- developer: 'Terry Yin'`. This confirms that the fault changed the behavior on the intended path, where `complete` read the configured user name, and that the run reached the intended assertion, which caught it.
- Restoration: the original file was copied back by an EXIT trap. Afterwards `git status --porcelain` showed only the `node_modules` symlink and `git diff` was empty, matching the pre-probe state. The rerun gave exit 0, job outcome `passed`, 0.7 s. The scratch worktree was then removed. The repository worktree was not edited.

**Finding.** The promise is protected. If the materializer drops the declared configured developer, the done-record credit tests fail on the developer field.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** 0.7 s for the baseline, 0.6 s for the fault run and 0.7 s for the restored run (measured, from the runner's per-job times file). The baseline wall clock including runner startup was 822 ms (measured).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human took part in this check, and no separate measure of human effort exists.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported measure of agent tokens or active time is exposed to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 57056 ms (measured), from 1794147367839 to 1794147424895 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
